assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Two concentric circles with centre O and radii 1 and sqrt 2; A and B on the inner circle, C on the outer circle, triangle ABC in blue, and the dotted circle with diameter AB inside the outer circle. The dashed line l_A through A perpendicular to AB cuts off a thick red arc of the outer circle on the side away from B, and the dashed line l_B through B cuts off a thick green arc on the side away from A.

difficulty_rationale: Needs the observation that the angle on the larger circle is never obtuse, a reduction of the other angles to a chord-cut arc, and an integral over the random central angle.
